nodes.description: admin address in BirdAdminStorage; root of every authorization check in BirdCore and BToken admin functions.
pendingAdmin address used for the two-step admin handover.
implementation address used as the delegatecall target by the BirdCore fallback.
pendingImplementation address for the two-step implementation handover.
Re-entrancy guard flag read and written by the nonReentrant modifier.
Total number of bTokens in circulation; updated by mint/redeem/seize.
Total outstanding borrows of the underlying plus accrued interest.
Total reserves of the underlying held by the market.
Global borrow interest accumulator used to compute account borrow balances.
Block number of the last interest accrual; used for freshness checks.
Mapping of account to bToken balance; mutated by transfer/mint/redeem/seize.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to approved amount.
Mapping of account to BorrowSnapshot (principal, interestIndex).
Fraction of interest set aside as reserves; admin controlled.
BControllerInterface used for all policy hooks and cross-market calls.
InterestRateModel contract used to read borrow/supply rates.
Initial exchange rate used when totalSupply is zero.
Mapping of bToken address to Market metadata (collateral factor, membership, bird flag).
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization, token sourcing and seizer identity.
BirdCore constructor that assigns admin = msg.sender.
Payable fallback of BirdCore that delegatecalls msg.data to the implementation.
Admin-only function to set the pending implementation address.
pendingImplementation-only function moving pendingImplementation into implementation.
Admin-only function to set the pending admin address in BirdCore.
pendingAdmin-only function that finalizes the admin handover.
BToken market initializer guarded by admin and one-time initialization checks.
Internal EIP-20 transfer routine performing allowance and balance math plus bController hooks.
External nonReentrant entrypoint moving msg.sender tokens to dst.
External nonReentrant entrypoint moving src tokens using spender allowance.
External approval writer for transferAllowances.
Accrues interest into totalBorrows/totalReserves/borrowIndex using block delta and CarefulMath.
Computes an account borrow balance from BorrowSnapshot and global borrowIndex.
Computes the exchange rate from cash, borrows, reserves and total supply.
Mints bTokens after pulling underlying from the minter and verifying bController policy.
Redeems bTokens, computing amounts then transferring underlying out before storage writes.
Creates a borrow after policy/freshness checks and transfers underlying out to the borrower.
Repays a borrow by pulling underlying in and decrementing account/total borrows.
Liquidation routine that repays the borrower and seizes collateral, possibly on another market.
Internal collateral seizure moving accountTokens from borrower to liquidator.
External nonReentrant seizure entrypoint that trusts msg.sender as the seizer token.
Admin-only reserve factor update after freshness and bounds checks.
Admin-only reserve reduction that transfers reserves out to admin.
Admin-only interest rate model replacement with marker check.
Internal view returning block.number; source of all freshness/timestamp checks.
Adds reserves by transferring underlying in from msg.sender and updating totalReserves.
delegatecall to the admin-controlled implementation address inside the fallback.
doTransferIn external call to the underlying asset (implementation supplied by BErc20).
doTransferOut external call pushing underlying/ETH to a user or admin.
External calls to bController policy hooks (Allowed/Verify) and liquidateCalculateSeizeTokens.
External call to another bToken's seize() during cross-market liquidation.
CarefulMath mulUInt/addUInt/subUInt/divUInt arithmetic and the exponential mul_/div_ helpers.
tokens parameter of transferTokens: amount of bTokens moved.
allowed local holding the bController.transferAllowed return code.
Caller supplied new reserve factor mantissa.
Caller supplied new InterestRateModel address.
currentBlockNumber local read from getBlockNumber() in accrueInterest.
borrowRateMantissa local returned by interestRateModel.getBorrowRate.
repayAmount parameter of liquidateBorrowFresh controlling the liquidation size.
seizeTokens local returned by bController.liquidateCalculateSeizeTokens.
reduceAmount parameter of _reduceReservesFresh.
totalReservesNew local computed as totalReserves - reduceAmount.

edges.reason: msg.sender must equal admin before the pending implementation can be changed.
msg.sender must equal pendingImplementation to accept the implementation role.
msg.sender must equal admin to set a new pending admin.
msg.sender must equal pendingAdmin to finalize the admin handover.
The constructor takes the deploy-time msg.sender as the initial privileged admin.
admin state variable is initialized directly from msg.sender.
initialize requires msg.sender == admin before configuring the market.
initialize compares the caller against the stored admin.
_setReserveFactorFresh rejects callers that are not admin.
_reduceReservesFresh rejects callers that are not admin.
_setInterestRateModelFresh rejects callers that are not admin.
seize passes msg.sender as the seizer token so a caller cannot forge the seizing market.
Only a listed bToken (via msg.sender) can pass the seizeAllowed hook.
The fallback reads the storage implementation address to route the delegatecall.
Every unmatched call is forwarded through a delegatecall to the implementation.
The delegatecall target is the admin-controlled implementation address.
The nonReentrant modifier uses _notEntered to guard redeemFresh against reentry.
The nonReentrant modifier uses _notEntered to guard borrowFresh against reentry.
mintFresh pulls the underlying in from the minter through doTransferIn.
redeemFresh performs an external transfer out before writing accounting state.
totalSupply/accountTokens are written after the external transfer out in redeemFresh.
borrowFresh transfers underlying to the borrower before updating borrow state.
totalBorrows and accountBorrows are updated after the external transfer out.
repayBorrowFresh pulls the repay amount in from the payer via doTransferIn.
_addReservesFresh transfers the addition in from msg.sender.
liquidateBorrowFresh calls seize() on another bToken mid-liquidation, an external callback vector.
Liquidation consults bController hooks for policy and seize token calculation.
transferTokens calls bController.transferAllowed and transferVerify hooks.
seizeInternal calls bController.seizeAllowed and seizeVerify hooks.
accrueInterest reads the per-block borrow rate from interestRateModel.
Interest, borrow index and reserve updates rely on CarefulMath helpers for overflow safety.
transferTokens uses subUInt/addUInt for allowance and balance math.
seizeInternal uses subUInt/addUInt for borrower and liquidator balances.
borrowRateMantissa must be below borrowRateMaxMantissa before being used in interest math.
accrueInterest depends on block.number for the interest accrual window and freshness checks.
currentBlockNumber is persisted into accrualBlockNumber after accrual.
getBlockNumber() produces the accrualBlockNumber written to storage.
The tokens parameter drives the debit/credit of accountTokens and allowance.
The bController.transferAllowed return value is stored in the allowed local.
A non-zero allowed value short-circuits transferTokens with a BController rejection.
newReserveFactorMantissa is bounded by reserveFactorMaxMantissa before use.
The parameter is written into the reserveFactorMantissa state variable.
newInterestRateModel must satisfy the isInterestRateModel marker before replacement.
The parameter is written into the interestRateModel state variable.
repayAmount sizes the repayment performed during liquidation.
seizeTokens comes from bController.liquidateCalculateSeizeTokens.
The computed seizeTokens is passed into the collateral seize call.
reduceAmount is validated against cash and totalReserves before the transfer out.
totalReservesNew = totalReserves - reduceAmount is written back to the reserves state variable.
approve writes the spender allowance into transferAllowances.
transfer delegates to transferTokens using msg.sender as both spender and src.
transferFrom delegates to transferTokens using msg.sender as the spender.
mintFresh calls bController.mintAllowed and mintVerify hooks.
repayBorrowFresh calls bController.repayBorrowAllowed and repayBorrowVerify hooks.
redeemFresh calls bController.redeemAllowed and redeemVerify hooks.
borrowFresh calls bController.borrowAllowed and borrowVerify hooks.

normalization_plan.reason: The tokens parameter only feeds the internal transfer math of transferTokens, so it is absorbed into that function node.
allowed is merely the return value of the bController hook call and is represented by the external call node.
The reserve factor parameter is only meaningful inside _setReserveFactorFresh and folds into it.
The new model parameter is validated and stored only inside _setInterestRateModelFresh.
currentBlockNumber is a short-lived local of accrueInterest and is folded into that function.
borrowRateMantissa is an intermediate rate value local to accrueInterest.
repayAmount is consumed exclusively by liquidateBorrowFresh for checks and repayment.
seizeTokens is produced by the bController call and immediately passed to the collateral seize call.
reduceAmount is validated and used only within _reduceReservesFresh.
totalReservesNew is a transient local computed and stored at the end of _reduceReservesFresh.
